name: CreateServiceNowTableRecord
label: Create ServiceNow Table Record
description: Creates a new record in a specified ServiceNow table using InstanceUrl + Credential ID/Token.

fields.name: CredentialId
fields.label: Credential ID / Token
fields.description: For BasicAuth → provide Base64(username:password). For OAuth2 → provide Bearer token.

fields.name: TableName
fields.label: Table Name or ID
fields.description: Name of the ServiceNow table (e.g., incident, change_request, problem).

fields.name: DataToSend
fields.label: Data to Send
fields.description: How to send data: Auto-map inputs, define manually, or send nothing.

selectOptions.label: Nothing
selectOptions.description: Sends an empty request body. ServiceNow may auto-populate default values.

selectOptions.label: Auto-map Input Data
selectOptions.description: Automatically maps input arguments (e.g., ShortDescription) to matching ServiceNow fields.

selectOptions.label: Define Below for Each Column
selectOptions.description: Manually specify each field and its value in a list.

fields.name: FieldsToSend
fields.label: Fields to Send
fields.description: List of key-value pairs representing field names and values to send.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from ServiceNow API.

fields.name: CreatedRecord
fields.label: Created Record
fields.description: The created record as JObject (contains sys_id, number, etc.).

fields.name: RecordId
fields.label: Record ID (sys_id)
fields.description: The sys_id of the created record. Use this for Update, Delete, Get operations.
